The odd partial sums must be checked. From the computed terms,
\[
S_8=126,\quad S_9=S_8+a_9=126+1=127.
\]
For \(n\ge 10\), \(S_{10}=126\). The next pair sum is
\[
a_{11}+a_{12}=\frac13-2<0,
\]
and all later pair sums are also negative, so later even partial sums are \(<126\). The only later odd partial sum exceeding \(S_{10}\) is
\[
S_{11}=126+\frac13<127.
\]
Earlier partial sums are at most \(S_8=126\). Therefore the maximum is

\[
\boxed{127}
\]
